newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC to procure 90 pct of parts via Internet--paper.
newsitem.headline: NEC to procure 90 pct of parts via Internet--paper.

text.p: NEC Corp plans to procure two trillion yen worth of components and materials annually through an Internet-based network, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Sunday.
The materials to be procured through the new system, which will be set up by the end of March 1998, will account for 90 percent of the company's procurement costs it said.
The system will link 300 Japanese parts suppliers and will be the largest domestic parts procurement network of any Japanese company, the paper said.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
